title: Dissociative psychological first aid

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Dissociative psychological first aid is defined as any behavioral technique which provides an acute and immediate assistance for behavior in dissociative cognition. These techniques encompass both dissuading dysfunctional behavior and encouraging functional behavior.

This page lists and describes the various dissociative psychological first aid techniques.

Immersion modifications

See also

*Tripsitting index
*Subjective effect index
*Dissociatives

References
